learning_outcomes.text: Calculate machine elements (motors, brakes, springs, etc.) for different applications.
Design and dimension welded and bolted joints.
Design friction bearings and lubrication systems.
Apply reliability and quality criteria in machine design.
Apply safety criteria in machine design.

syllabus_topics: Friction or plain bearings (friction, lubrication and lubricants)
Reliability, Quality and Safety in Machine Design
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a total grade equal to or greater than 5 out of 10 (50%) must be obtained. Additionally, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 must be obtained in the final theoretical-practical exam. If this minimum is not reached in the exam, the course will not be passed even if the total sum of grades is 5 or greater. For extraordinary calls, the same evaluation criteria will be maintained. For differentiated evaluation, assessment will be based on a theoretical or practical exam of the course content (90%) and exercises related to laboratory practices (10%).
bibliography: Norton, R. “Diseño de Máquinas” Ed. Pearson, 2011.
Shigley: Diseño en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ed. McGraw-Hill, 1985

Cortizo et. al. “Elementos de Máquinas. Teoría y Problemas”. Ediuno 2010.
